subject.title: [Feature]: WebUI notification system, cron job management popups, and context monitor integration

question: Should OpenClaw add a core Control UI in-app notification/action queue for cron results and context pressure, and if so which related action surfaces should share that contract?
rationale: Current main has several partial notification, cron, and context surfaces, but the remaining request changes Control UI product architecture and overlaps open notification/action issues rather than being a narrow bug repair.

options.title: Scope core notification queue first
options.body: Define one connected-Control-UI notification/action contract and then wire cron-finished and context-pressure events into it in focused follow-up work.

options.title: Fold into related action issues
options.body: Make #53228 or #46656 the canonical shared action/notification API work and treat this issue as UX requirements for that larger contract.

options.title: Defer broad in-app toasts
options.body: Keep the current inline cron, Web Push, and context-ring surfaces only, and close this if maintainers reject a core toast/snooze layer for now.

recommendation.title: Scope core notification queue first
recommendation.body: Define one connected-Control-UI notification/action contract and then wire cron-finished and context-pressure events into it in focused follow-up work.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining product boundary touches cron notification routing history and prior maintainer-side review comments on this issue.
